_note: Keystroke-Level Model operator times in seconds. K, P, B, H, M from Card, Moran & Newell (1980/1983) as summarised by Kieras (2001), 'Using the Keystroke-Level Model to Estimate Execution Times'. R (system response) is measured per page in evidence/sources.csv (median of 3 HTML GETs, a lower bound on perceived load). Reading time is NOT part of KLM; it is reported separately as an upper bound using the mean silent reading rate for English non-fiction from Brysbaert (2019), 'How many words do we read per minute?', Journal of Memory and Language 109.
